sources_used: Google/web search (UK arcade, StepManiaX Hollywood Bowl locations, venue status)

findings.name: Hollywood Bowl Torquay
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv games list (updated 2025-09-16): Tomb Raider Arcade, World's Largest Pac-Man, Cruis'n Blast, Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, MotoGP Arcade, Deadstorm Pirates, Halo Fireteam Raven, NERF Arcade, NBA Hoops. No music/rhythm entries.
findings.note: Not on Hollywood Bowl Group SMX install list of 15 centres (Steve Smart 2024-07-17: Basildon, Cardiff, Colchester, Dundee, Dunfermline, Eastleigh, Finchley, Glasgow Springfield Quay, Leicester, Merry Hill, Portsmouth, Sheffield, Stevenage, Stockton, Tunbridge Wells). Absence from that list is not positive proof of zero rhythm ever; no local player posts found. Treat as unknown for map games.

findings.name: Hollywood Bowl Tunbridge Wells
findings.evidence_quote: We now have 15 StepManiaX installed @HollywoodBowlUK, latest ones being Dunfermline and today in Tunbridge wells
findings.note: Install confirmed by Hollywood Bowl Amusement Support Manager with photo. ZIv lists StepManiaX (65" Deluxe) as unconfirmed from same tweet (updated 2024-07-18). Player @dancemaniax still cites Tunbridge Wells SMX as nearest option 2026-06-14. No count stated.

findings.name: Hollywood Bowl Washington
findings.evidence_quote: Has various shooters, racers, luck-based ticket-winning games, no dance machines. Does have some large piano key style game but I don't know what that is
findings.note: Positive ZIv note of no dance machines. Site not on Jul 2024 official 15-site SMX install list. Piano-keys style is redemption (Grand Piano Keys class), not a valid rhythm slug. Confidence only likely because ZIv note is 2022; no later player contradiction found.

findings.name: Hollywood Bowl Watford
findings.evidence_quote: Games listed: Tomb Raider Arcade, Cruis'n Blast, Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, Super Bikes 3, X Games Snowboarder, Halo Fireteam Raven (4P), NERF Arcade, Pac-Man Chomp Mania. No music games.
findings.note: Woodside Leisure Park site. Not on Jul 2024 SMX list of 15. ZIv inventory stale (COVID-era note). No positive 'no music' statement and no recent full audit; unknown.

findings.name: Hollywood Bowl Watford Atria
findings.evidence_quote: Small arcade with a some ticket games and a few racers, not too much of note. Listed: Minecraft Dungeons, Cruis'n Blast, Fast & Furious Arcade (2022), Mario Kart GP DX, Super Bikes 3, Halo Fireteam Raven, pushers/redemption. No music games.
findings.note: Separate Atria/Harlequin centre from Woodside Watford. Not on Jul 2024 SMX list. No rhythm evidence; not enough for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Hollywood Bowl Wellingborough
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, Jurassic Park Arcade (2015), Flying Tickets, Storm. No music section.
findings.note: Not on Jul 2024 SMX list of 15. Sparse ZIv list; no positive no-rhythm statement.

findings.name: Hollywood Bowl Wigan
findings.evidence_quote: No games at this location. (ZIv empty games table; last update 2023-02-25)
findings.note: Empty ZIv is silence, not proof. Not on Jul 2024 SMX list. No independent inventory found.

findings.name: Hollywood Bowl Worthing
findings.evidence_quote: Small but well kept. Typical newer arcade and redemption games. No games at this location. (empty ZIv table)
findings.note: Not on Jul 2024 SMX list. Empty ZIv inventory; unknown for rhythm.

findings.name: Hollywood Bowl Xscape Milton Keynes
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv games (updated 2023-02-13): Minecraft Dungeons, Asphalt 9, Cruis'n Blast, MotoGP Arcade, Grand Piano Keys, Monopoly Pusher, Spongebob pusher, Space Invaders Frenzy. No StepManiaX/music section.
findings.note: Some Xscape/chain social posts use stock 'Step Maniax or Mario Kart' copy, but Milton Keynes is not on Steve Smart's Jul 2024 list of 15 SMX sites. Do not attach SMX without site-specific proof. Ambiguous marketing vs official list = unknown.

findings.name: Hollywood Bowl at the O2
findings.evidence_quote: Detailed inventory updated 2024-12-30: Cruis'n Blast, Hot Wheels, Mario Kart GP DX, NFS Heat Takedown, Super Bikes 3, Halo Raven, Jurassic Park, Walking Dead, many redemption/pushers/simulators. No music games listed. Note: location under refurbishment; some cabs in ICON outlet pop-up.
findings.note: Not on Jul 2024 SMX list of 15. Instagram ads mentioning Step Maniax appear to be multi-brand marketing, not a site-specific cab claim. Large ZIv list has no rhythm; still not a positive 'no music' attestation, so unknown not confirmed_none.

findings.name: House of Games (Center Parcs Elveden Forest)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) Comment: Game sometimes fails regularly, and will sometimes not let you play. £1.00 for 1 song. Moderate. Updated 2026-01-31.
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade is a music game but not a named map slug, so mapped to other. Guest-only Center Parcs arcade. Historic comments mention Dancing Stage Fusion (DDR) years ago; not on current game list. No count beyond presence.

findings.name: Hunstanton Pier
findings.evidence_quote: Just the usual redemption type here, but some arcade games here. Listed: Minecraft Dungeons, Fast & Furious Arcade (2022), Ultra Moto VR, Halo Raven, Luigi's Mansion, House of the Dead Scarlet Dawn, Pixel Chase, King Kong, Virtual Rabbids. No music games.
findings.note: Seaside pier amusement. No rhythm evidence in recent ZIv list; unknown not confirmed_none.

findings.name: JUMP INC
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) Comment: Still turned on for some reason. Graphics are really messed up to the point where its unplayable... £1.00 Not Working. Updated 2024-09-04.
findings.note: Meadowhall trampoline park, rebranded AirHop Sheffield with full park refurb after the ZIv report. Guitar Hero cab was present but not working in 2024-09. Post-refurb survival unconfirmed. Mapped to other (not a named slug). Do not claim working SMX/DDR.

findings.name: Jimmy G's
findings.evidence_quote: Jimmy G's is a very pleasant seaside arcade opposite the Harbour in Ramsgate. it special is the array of old EM pinball tables from the 1960s and 70s.
findings.note: Ramsgate Harbour Parade family amusements / pinball focus. ZIv has empty notes. jimmygs.co.uk is Leysdown-on-Sea (different site). No rhythm game evidence found for Ramsgate.

findings.name: Jokers
findings.evidence_quote: Shard/ZIv notes only: Ferrari F355 Challenge, Star Wars Trilogy Arcade, Super Bikes, The Fast and the Furious. No music games listed.
findings.note: Ingoldmells seaside area (multiple Joker/arcade names nearby). No modern rhythm inventory found. Ambiguous name; do not attach another venue's list.

findings.name: Jump 360 Stockton
findings.evidence_quote: Trampoline park with arcade. Games: Minecraft Dungeons, MotoGP Arcade, Down The Clown, NERF Arcade, Rabbids & Ladders, Spinner Frenzy. No music games.
findings.note: Not Hollywood Bowl Stockton (which is on the SMX list). This is Jump 360 trampoline. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Junk Yard Golf Club Newcastle
findings.evidence_quote: They have a few arcade games near the entrance. Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) 1 Token to play 2 Tokens for premium songs Perfect. Also Pac-Man, Point Blank, Sharpshooter, House of the Dead. Updated 2026-05-08.
findings.note: Mini-golf social venue with a short cab row. Guitar Hero Arcade mapped to other. No dedicated Bemani/SMX/DDR reported.

findings.name: K's Funworld
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Claw Machine, Space Invaders Frenzy. No music games.
findings.note: Swanage High Street small amusement. Sparse list; unknown.

findings.name: Kebhouze - Oxford Street.
findings.evidence_quote: Kebhouze - CLOSED. 159 Oxford Street, London W1D
findings.note: Opened Dec 2023 with upstairs arcade/MAME (ZIv: MAME Board only; no dedicated rhythm). TripAdvisor marks CLOSED; Instagram mentions temporary closure; Uber Eats closed as of Jan 2026. Whether permanent is unclear; map as closed until reopening evidence. Even when open, only MAME board (not a named rhythm slug).

findings.name: Kessingland Beach Holiday Park
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs noted on shard/ZIv: Super Bikes (2P) only. No music games.
findings.note: Holiday park amusement. No rhythm evidence found.

findings.name: King Alfreds
findings.evidence_quote: Also a Korean PIU Extra cab in 2002/03 at the height of the dancegames craze. ... Still has a few arcade cabs left over... Games listed 2013: Virtua Fighter 4, Sega Rally, Big Buck Safari, Point Blank, Virtua Striker 3.
findings.note: King Alfred Leisure Centre Hove/Brighton. PIU was historical (2002/03), not current. ZIv last update 2013. Centre still operates pending redevelopment (new build targeted ~2028). Current arcade presence and games unknown; do not claim pump_it_up.

findings.name: Kingdom Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs noted: Megatouch (series), Pac-Man Pusher (4P), Time Crisis 4. No music games.
findings.note: Burntisland High Street seaside amusement. Active social presence as dog-friendly arcade; no rhythm inventory found.

findings.name: Kino Amusement
findings.evidence_quote: Family friendly amusements in Walton-On-The-Naze. Instagram: FIND US ON THE SEAFRONT WALTON-ON-THE-NAZE, CO14 8QD. ZIv notes MotoGP Arcade; Star Wars: Battle Pod Flat Screen Edition.
findings.note: Walton-on-the-Naze (CO14). Seaside amusement, no rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Lakeside Superbowl Banbury
findings.evidence_quote: Discobowl Banbury: Cherwell Centre George Street, Banbury. (Same address as former Lakeside Superbowl.) TripAdvisor: Banbury Bowl ... taken under new ownership in October 2019 & refurbished in November 2019.
findings.note: Operator/name chain: Lakeside Superbowl -> MFA Bowl (admin) -> Banbury Bowl / Discobowl. ZIv empty and 2012-dated. No public rhythm cab list found under new branding. Ambiguous identity for game attach; unknown.

findings.name: Lane7 (Birmingham)
findings.evidence_quote: Bowling alley in city centre. Games: Space Invaders (FREE), Track & Field (FREE). Updated 2024-09-23.
findings.note: Very short free-play cab list. No music games reported. Not a positive no-rhythm attestation for the whole venue; unknown.

findings.name: Lane7 (Newcastle Upon Tyne)
findings.evidence_quote: No more Dancing Stage Euromix unfortunately, as well as HOTD 4. Unsure of where the machines of went, but they've decided to just have newer games sadly. This would be fine if they weren't mostly redemption... Current list: MAME Board, Daytona Championship USA, Down The Clown, Ice Ball FX, King of the Hammer, Toilet Bowl Toss, Hoops FX. Updated 2025-02-16.
findings.note: Positive removal of Dancing Stage Euromix (DDR). Prior player comments reference Euromix; site information text states it is gone. Current known floor is redemption/racing/MAME only.

findings.name: Lane7 (Sheffield)
findings.evidence_quote: No games at this location. Comments 2024-10: Looked all around last evening, it's gone. They shifted things around and got some new games including an axe throwing game. Absolute trash job looking after their SuperNOVA cab. They scrapped it.
findings.note: DDR SuperNOVA was present and later scrapped per regulars. Positive evidence current venue has no rhythm cab. Do not re-list SuperNOVA.

findings.name: Las Vegas
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) £1.00 for 1 song. Updated 2018-05-04. Arcade may be closed early during Winter.
findings.note: Southend Marine Parade seaside arcade. Only listed game is Guitar Hero Arcade (other). 2018 data is old; presence 2026 unverified. No newer contradiction found.

findings.name: Las Vegas Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs noted: Ring Riders, Scud Race. No music games.
findings.note: Hemsby Norfolk. Common seaside name; no rhythm evidence. Do not confuse with other Las Vegas Amusements sites.

findings.name: Las Vegas Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Barmouth Promenade entry. ZIv has no games listed on the shard snapshot; no music inventory found.
findings.note: Barmouth Gwynedd. Ambiguous chain name; empty inventory; unknown.

findings.name: LaserZone
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs noted historically: Mario Kart Arcade GP 2, Time Crisis 4, Virtua Cop 3. Venue brand is laser tag (LaserZone Huddersfield still advertises laser arena).
findings.note: Primary business is laser tag. Old ZIv cab list has no rhythm. Current video-arcade floor unclear; unknown.

findings.name: Lazer Rush
findings.evidence_quote: Whitstable industrial-estate laser venue. ZIv has no games listed; hours only.
findings.note: Laser tag style venue. No rhythm evidence; no positive confirmed_none statement about amusements.

findings.name: Lazer Tag Nottingham
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs noted: Point Blank 2, Spiderman. Website lasertagnottingham.com still listed.
findings.note: Laser tag venue with a couple of non-rhythm cabs. No music games found.

findings.name: Leisure 2000
findings.evidence_quote: Quite a nice selection of games here, including mostly redemption games. Listed (updated 2025-09-16): Minecraft Dungeons, Asphalt 9, Mario Kart GP DX, Super Bikes 3, Fast and Furious Super Cars, Axe Master, Connect 4 Hoops, Dinosaur Era, Monopoly, Pac-Man Pusher, Sonic Blast Ball, King Kong II, World Football Pro. No music section.
findings.note: Paignton Torbay Road seaside arcade. Recent broad inventory has no rhythm; still silence is not confirmed_none under project rules.

findings.name: Level X Middlesborough
findings.evidence_quote: Entertainment venue ... arcade games, go karting, crazy golf, bowling. Very large 2024-07-17 inventory (Daytona, Luigi's Mansion, HOTD Scarlet Dawn, many Bay Tek redemption titles, Mario & Sonic Tokyo 2020). No music/rhythm section.
findings.note: Captain Cook Square Middlesbrough (spelling). Extensive ZIv list without SMX/DDR/etc. No positive 'no music' line; unknown. Website levelx.co.uk/middlesbrough still active.

findings.name: Lewisham Lanes
findings.evidence_quote: Owned by Disco Bowl. Updated 2025-09-29 detailed Namco-style list: Minecraft Dungeons, World's Largest Pac-Man, Hot Wheels, Mario Kart GP DX, Nitro Trucks, Super Bikes 2, Aliens Armageddon, Halo Raven, many redemption. No music games.
findings.note: Still open as Lewisham Lanes / Discobowl. Not a Hollywood Bowl SMX site. Recent full inventory without rhythm; unknown not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Lightwater Valley Theme Park
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs noted: Claw Machine, Ford Racing Full Blown, Sega Golden Gun, Transformers Human Alliance. Park website active Summer 2026.
findings.note: Theme park midways/arcade. No rhythm evidence. Ownership changes noted in press; game floor not re-audited publicly for music cabs.

findings.name: Llandudno Pier
findings.evidence_quote: All music games gone as of 17/04/17. So none in Llandudno at all anymore. Shore side arcade made predominantly a redemption arcade... Comment ~1 year ago: Not a lot to see here (In terms of video games).
findings.note: Positive historical statement that music games were removed. Remaining listed cabs are racers/shooters/redemption/pinball (inventory last bulk update 2021). Confidence likely due to age of the music-gone note; no post-2017 evidence of SMX/DDR return.

findings.name: Loading Bar
findings.evidence_quote: Sat next to the Pier right on the beach, Loading Brighton is open... Console area / VIP / decking. ZIv games (2023-05-25): Street Fighter II Champion Edition, Tekken Tag Tournament, Street Fighter II pinball, Le Mans 24. No music/rhythm cabs.
findings.note: Active games bar (console + a few arcade cabinets). No dedicated rhythm game found. DesignMyNight describes Mario Kart/SF2/Switch/PS, not DDR/SMX.
